name: Kohei
source:
The big brother type who takes you under his wing and welcomes you to Rinkai ward, Kohei keeps his eye on everyone. Despite not always seeing eye to eye with the group, he's always there for you when it counts…

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.cops]Google Play[/url]]
